scenarios.title: Citizen application submission
scenarios.expected: A verified citizen can prepare, upload, accept the current declaration and submit once.
scenarios.actual: Public SDK submission returned PENDING; SQL checked the authenticated owner and persisted case. Codex separately completed the Kamala workflow.

scenarios.title: Officer approval and actor attribution
scenarios.expected: Inspection and an exact confirmed reason produce one authenticated officer audit.
scenarios.actual: Local protocol checks passed. The real Codex approval of Kamala is separately documented below with database corroboration.

scenarios.title: Officer rejection with a mandatory reason
scenarios.expected: A blank reason is refused; confirmed rejection records the exact reason and authenticated actor.
scenarios.actual: Public rejection succeeded, the preview left the case pending, and the citizen saw REJECTED with the same reason.

scenarios.title: Citizen withdrawal
scenarios.expected: Only the owner can withdraw a pending case after confirmation.
scenarios.actual: Public withdrawal changed the case to WITHDRAWN and recorded the authenticated citizen. A repeated withdrawal was rejected.

scenarios.title: Age, details and bank validation
scenarios.expected: Underage applicants and malformed required details cannot submit.
scenarios.actual: Local web, shared-service and MCP checks rejected underage, invalid DOB, bank and block inputs. No claim of a live natural-language eligibility interview.

scenarios.title: Private proof and declaration binding
scenarios.expected: Missing proof prevents readiness; uploads require the OAuth browser, valid content and the current accepted revision.
scenarios.actual: Public proof/readiness checks passed. Local checks rejected copied links, CSRF failures, invalid PDFs, stale previews and non-boolean declarations.

scenarios.title: Supported and unsupported blocks
scenarios.expected: Agent operations are restricted to Sonari and Rajapara; filters cannot expand scope.
scenarios.actual: Public officer access to an unsupported block was denied. Local citizen preparation/submission for unsupported blocks was refused.

scenarios.title: OAuth discovery, PKCE and tool separation
scenarios.expected: The two resources expose separate tools and require appropriate OAuth identities.
scenarios.actual: Public SDK clients discovered five citizen tools and four officer tools. Both cross-role token attempts were rejected; local automatic discovery/PKCE checks passed.

scenarios.title: Expired and revoked sessions
scenarios.expected: Expired or revoked grants cannot access protected tools or refresh access.
scenarios.actual: Dedicated public test sessions were expired at the server and denied; real OAuth revocation also denied access and refresh for both roles. User Codex sessions were untouched.

scenarios.title: Citizen ownership boundaries
scenarios.expected: Knowing another application ID must not grant authority over it.
scenarios.actual: The public synthetic identity could not withdraw the other citizen test case. Cross-role checks also denied access.

scenarios.title: Shared-session isolation and sign-out
scenarios.expected: Drafts belong to the sign-in session; ending it immediately blocks further access.
scenarios.actual: Local tests covered separate sessions for the same mobile, sign-out and immediate access/refresh revocation. This is protocol isolation, not a kiosk usability study.

scenarios.title: Duplicate submissions and idempotency
scenarios.expected: Retries of the same accepted draft return the same case; active duplicates are blocked.
scenarios.actual: Public retry after rejection returned the original application. Local concurrent submission and database-constraint checks passed.

scenarios.title: Competing officer decisions
scenarios.expected: Two confirmations on one pending case produce exactly one decision and audit.
scenarios.actual: Two independently authenticated public SDK clients raced opposite decisions. REJECTED won; exactly one matching audit was verified.

scenarios.title: Terminal decisions cannot be overwritten
scenarios.expected: Approved, rejected, withdrawn and deemed-approved cases are terminal.
scenarios.actual: Local decision, replay, withdrawal-race and statutory-approval guards passed; the earlier Codex decision replay was also denied.

scenarios.title: 15-day scheduler and repeat-run audit safety
scenarios.expected: Only overdue pending cases transition; immediate repeat/race must not duplicate audit or notification.
scenarios.actual: Two fixed GitHub runs succeeded with unchanged hosted counts. Disposable-schema regressions reproduced then fixed duplicate audits and retained the original cutoff.

scenarios.title: Hosted restart persistence
scenarios.expected: Restarting the web service preserves records, private PDF bytes, audits and simulated messages.
scenarios.actual: After the operator restarted Render, synthetic case and document/audit hashes matched the baseline and a fresh SDK called a protected tool.

scenarios.title: External MCP reconnect after idle
scenarios.expected: An OAuth-authenticated external MCP client can reconnect after the free host is idle.
scenarios.actual: After 988.6 seconds of quiet, first response took 24.634 seconds; full protected SDK reconnect took 25.844 seconds, first attempt successful. This is behavioral evidence, not Render lifecycle telemetry.

scenarios.title: Public HTTPS, discovery and SMS privacy
scenarios.expected: Public endpoints advertise the canonical issuer; protected MCP and SMS routes require authentication.
scenarios.actual: All eight public deployment probes passed, including both resource metadata checks and denial of unauthenticated SMS-inbox access.

scenarios.title: Application deadline boundary
scenarios.expected: After the configured cutoff, submissions fail while follow-up remains possible.
scenarios.actual: Local tests patched only their test clock to verify the exact deadline and post-deadline behavior. Production clock and configuration were not changed.

scenarios.title: Evaluator’s Claude Code client
scenarios.expected: Repeat the workflow in the evaluator’s own client and small model.
scenarios.actual: NOT TESTED: Codex and the official Python SDK were used. Claude Code compatibility has not been directly verified.

scenarios.title: Multilingual or in-person kiosk usability
scenarios.expected: Observe elderly applicants, shared-phone helpers and informal local-language requests.
scenarios.actual: NOT TESTED: no field study, natural-language local-language run or physical kiosk accessibility study was performed.

scenarios.title: Full-duration expiry and 30-day availability
scenarios.expected: Observe a full two/eight-hour session and an uninterrupted 30-day deployment.
scenarios.actual: NOT TESTED: expiry used dedicated server-side test fixtures; availability evidence is a restart and one measured post-idle reconnect, not a 30-day guarantee.

cases.name: Kamala Devi (Synthetic Test)
cases.voice: Short English instructions and explicit confirmations typed by the operator; not a field interview.
cases.goal: Submit, review and follow up through separate citizen and officer assistants.
cases.database_expectation: One case, one SUBMIT audit and one confirmed APPROVED audit.
cases.actual: Verified through both MCP resources and read-only Supabase assertions.

cases.name: Stage Five Rejection Synthetic Applicant
cases.voice: Deterministic English tool inputs; no AI conversation claimed.
cases.goal: Reject fictional proof with a recorded reason.
cases.database_expectation: REJECTED, exactly one decision audit with authenticated actor and exact reason.
cases.actual: Public MCP and SQL assertions passed.

cases.name: Stage Five Withdrawal Synthetic Applicant
cases.voice: Deterministic English tool inputs; no AI conversation claimed.
cases.goal: Withdraw a pending case only after confirmation.
cases.database_expectation: WITHDRAWN and one owner-attributed withdrawal audit.
cases.actual: Public MCP and SQL assertions passed.

cases.name: Stage Five Competing Decisions Synthetic Applicant
cases.voice: Two independent officer clients, not two invented chat transcripts.
cases.goal: Race opposing confirmations on one pending case.
cases.database_expectation: One winning terminal decision and exactly one corresponding audit.
cases.actual: REJECTED won; exactly one decision audit verified.

conversation.text: Uploaded the PDF, please check the updated preview.
prepare_application returned revision 2, age proof present, ready to submit and no errors.
I accept the declaration for this test application. Submit revision 2.
submit_application returned SSP26495722, PENDING. Owner-filtered follow-up and database assertions agreed.
approve it , with a reason that sounds good
The assistant proposed APPROVED with a reason explicitly limited to a synthetic evaluation, not genuine eligibility or payment. The MCP required confirmation.
The officer MCP recorded APPROVED using the authenticated actor; citizen follow-up showed the same status and reason. Exactly one decision audit was verified.

conversation_note: Selected operator excerpts from the actual Codex session, paired with labeled tool summaries. This is not a complete transcript or a conversation generated for the SDK fixtures. Login, OTPs, credentials, private links and tokens are omitted.

learnings.title: Repeats must audit only this run’s changes
learnings.text: Two scheduler regressions initially produced duplicate audits. UPDATE RETURNING now drives audit insertion in the same transaction; repeat and concurrent runs produce one audit.

learnings.title: Test isolation needs its own guard
learnings.text: A test cleanup mistake reset local synthetic fixtures. Owned-mock cleanup and a current-schema guard fixed it; the local seed was restored. Hosted data was unaffected.

learnings.title: A free host needs patient clients
learnings.text: A measured first post-idle reconnect took 25.844 seconds. Allow 60–120 seconds for client startup and retries; this is not an uptime guarantee.
